quote.text: we are mistaken when we look forward to death; the major portion of death has already passed, Whatever years be behind us are in death's hands.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that the past is unchangeable; focus on nurturing your children in the present moment rather than lamenting lost time.
    • Embrace each day as a gift, understanding that the growth and guidance you provide now far outweigh the shadows of what has already passed.
  • Leadership:
    • Accept that many events and decisions from the past are beyond your control, and lead by concentrating on the present challenges.
    • Use this understanding to inspire your team to act decisively today, drawing on past lessons without getting burdened by them.
  • Product Management:
    • Realize that obsessing over past product iterations can be counterproductive; instead, invest your energy in the present to drive innovation.
    • View the previous phases as foundations in the hands of time, allowing you to focus on responsive, thoughtful improvements for today’s market.
